title: Reopening a completed work order leaves its inactive part inactive
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test.
  • Create a work order, work order 1, for this test, with part A on its line, line 1, and complete it, not invoiced.
  • Set part A inactive after work order 1 is complete.
  • Start on work order 1.
custom_steps:
1. Click the three-dot button in work order 1's header.
  2. Click Uncomplete.
  3. Click Parts in the top bar.
  4. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  5. Click the Inactive tab.
  6. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  7. Click the Active tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order menu opens.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1 is no longer complete and line 1 still shows part A.

Step 3:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 4:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 5:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 6:

  • Part A is still listed on the Inactive tab.

Step 7:

  • Part A is not listed on the Active tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-E5: “Reopening a completed work order does not make any part on it active.”
